title: Bias in Language Models: Beyond Trick Tests and Towards RUTEd Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring gender-occupation bias by comparing next-word probabilities of male versus female words in short decontextualized prompts (standard benchmarks) against the proportion of gendered pronouns generated in long-form realistic text tasks (children's bedtime stories, user personas, and ESL learning exercises), calculating metrics for neutrality, skew, and stereotype.
